actions.action: Higher offline card limit during the migration

message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, 12:00 CT, Cobalt moves to a new core banking system. For those 36 hours the app is read-only: you can see your balance, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards are paused. From this week your paycheck shows up in Cobalt up to 2 days early, so a Friday Dec 11 paycheck arrives by Wednesday Dec 9 and you can move it before the weekend. Card payments work offline up to $250 each that weekend, and we added support staff for the coming weeks. The switch can run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app.
why:
Paycheck customers are paid Fri Dec 11, the day before the app freezes.
Early pay lets them move that money before the weekend; permanent, so it also builds loyalty.
More support staff keeps waits short when questions peak.

actions.action: Savings rate boost, new money only

message: Thank you for staying with Cobalt through our system move. For the next 4 weeks we add 0.5 points to the savings rate on new money you add, on balances up to $50,000. Money already in savings earns the usual rate.
why:
Half of deposits sit with large-balance savers, who compare rates every week.
Rivals will target them after the migration weekend.
New money only halves the cost and rewards those who add rather than all balances.
